extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication covering ten enlargement countries: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, artificial intelligence, e-government, e-services, broadband, roaming, 5G, wallet, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data protection, connectivity, single market, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the North Macedonia passages in section III.1 (page 5) and the conclusions (paragraph 14, page 32), and sections III.2 to III.4. Annex I (third-party indices) and Annex II (statistics, page 60 converted by text recognition) have no in-scope indicators; the 'basic digital skills' rows are not linked to an in-scope recommendation (R2). Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Left out: cybercrime and cyber-enabled crime (page 13, R21); passages on Ukraine, Moldova and Georgia; general references to the green and digital transitions in the Growth Plan and IPA III. No North Macedonia-specific technology claim and no Chapter 2 material found in this document. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
